characters.name: Herreper
characters.prompt: A humble young Norwegian farm boy from the early 15th century, dressed in slightly worn woolen clothes and simple leather shoes. He has a determined yet modest expression, messy brown hair peeking out from under a simple cap, and a sturdy build from working on a small family farm.

characters.name: The Cat
characters.prompt: A sleek and clever Norwegian forest cat with a shiny, thick fur coat and piercing green eyes. She appears regal despite being a simple cat, hinting at her hidden royal nature. Her posture and expression convey intelligence and resourcefulness.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A dignified Norwegian king from the mid-17th century, wearing a richly adorned velvet robe with fur trim. He has a neatly trimmed grey beard, a golden crown studded with gemstones, and carries himself with noble authority.

characters.name: The Troll
characters.prompt: A towering, gruff troll reminiscent of old Norwegian folklore, with stone-like skin, bushy hair, and a fierce scowl. He stands in ragged clothing and has large, sharp teeth, embodying both strength and menace in a Scandinavian mountain setting.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.prompt: A radiant young princess newly freed from a curse, wearing a glimmering gold-trimmed gown appropriate for the late 17th century. She has graceful features, flowing blonde hair, and a confident yet gentle demeanor, reflecting her transformation from cat to royalty.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a Norwegian fairytale setting from the 15th century, featuring Herreper standing before a grand silver castle with gates of brass, silver, and gold. The cat stands by his side, looking poised and clever. To one side, a regal King observes them with curiosity, while in the distance, a menacing Troll lurks near the edge of the forest. The sky is bright, and the Norwegian landscape is lush with pine trees and rolling hills. Everything should convey an old-world atmosphere, rich with medieval Nordic details.
modernMainImagePrompt: Set the tale in a contemporary Norwegian cityscape. Herreper, dressed in casual modern clothing and sneakers, arrives with a sleek cat at a large, modern glass-and-steel building (standing in for the castle). A modern business-suited King welcomes them, surrounded by skyscrapers and cars. A hulking figure, wearing urban street attire and representing the Troll, stands off to one side, adding a touch of current-day realism. Include small nods to Norwegian culture throughout.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, colorful illustration for young children showing a friendly, smiling Herreper in simple old-fashioned clothes. The cat has big, friendly eyes and a cheerful demeanor. The King wears a shiny royal crown and a red cape. The Troll appears large and goofy, not too scary, with soft, rounded features. The enchanted castle sparkles in the background, with lively birds and friendly farm animals in a peaceful Norwegian countryside.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Skap et norsk folkeeventyrbilde fra tidlig 1800-tall: Herreper i enkle bondetøy, og en klok katt ved siden av ham. Et glitrende sølvslott troner i bakgrunnen, med kongefamilien og en stor, lurvete trollskikkelse i utkanten av scenen. Stemningen skal være varm og eventyrlig, med grønne sletter og furutrær rundt.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create a 15th-century Norwegian fairytale scene with Herreper in his humble peasant attire, accompanied by the clever cat. A gleaming silver castle stands in the background, featuring gates of brass, silver, and gold. Show the majestic King observing from one side, while a towering Troll lurks near a pine forest. The mood is magical and historical, capturing the essence of an old Norwegian folktale.
